categories.main_business_segments: China Chippacking Technology Co., Ltd. (Qipai Technology) primarily operates in integrated circuit (IC) packaging and testing services. Its product portfolio includes MEMS, Flip Chip (FC), Qipai, CPC, SOP, SOT, LQFP, QFN/DFN, CDFN/CQFN, DIP, TO, and PDFN series, serving sectors such as consumer electronics, information communication, smart home, IoT, industrial automation, and automotive electronics. The company also provides wafer testing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced IC packaging technologies including 5G MIMO base station GaN microwave RF power amplifier plastic packaging, high-density large matrix IC packaging, small-sized pin-design packaging solutions, customized packaging structure design, Flip Chip (FC), MEMS packaging, power device packaging for SiC and GaN chips, and copper clip interconnect technology. It employs flexible production modes with lean manufacturing, quality management systems, and digital factory initiatives integrating MES, APS, EAP, and ERP systems for intelligent production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Qipai Technology's primary customers are IC chip design companies that outsource wafer manufacturing and packaging/testing. The end markets served include consumer electronics (smartphones, laptops, smart TVs, wearables), information communication, smart home devices, IoT, industrial automation, and automotive electronics. The company actively targets leading customers and expands into emerging sectors like AI, automotive electronics, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Guangdong Province, including Shenzhen and Dongguan. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and serves domestic and international markets, with a small portion of revenue from overseas sales. The company benefits from its location in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, a major electronics and semiconductor hub.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qipai Technology operates primarily in the downstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in IC packaging and testing services. It acts as an OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) provider, receiving wafers from foundries and delivering packaged and tested chips to chip design companies for integration into electronic products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in advanced packaging technologies such as 5G GaN RF power amplifier packaging, high-density large matrix packaging, small-sized pin packaging, customized packaging designs, MEMS packaging, and power device packaging for SiC and GaN chips. It invests significantly in developing new products and processes, expanding testing capabilities, and enhancing production efficiency. The company also focuses on intelligent manufacturing, lean production, and quality management to maintain competitiveness and meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through processing fees for IC packaging and testing services, including wafer testing and chip packaging. The company also sells a limited volume of self-purchased packaged chips to customers. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance, mainly via direct sales to chip design companies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Qipai Technology is one of the largest domestic IC packaging and testing enterprises in South China, with strong quality management and technological innovation capabilities. It competes in a highly competitive market with major domestic and international OSAT providers such as ASE, Amkor, JCET, and others. The company focuses on niche advanced packaging technologies and regional advantages to maintain and grow its market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 666.6 million, a 20.25% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -102.1 million, showing reduced losses compared to prior years. Total assets reached about RMB 2 billion, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D. The company has experienced steady revenue growth driven by market recovery and increased orders, despite ongoing net losses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qipai Technology emphasizes its advanced packaging technology portfolio, including proprietary packaging forms like CPC, Qipai, and CDFN/CQFN series, and its capabilities in high-density, small-size, and customized packaging solutions. The company leverages its strong R&D, quality management, and intelligent manufacturing to provide high-reliability, cost-effective packaging and testing services tailored to customer needs, particularly in emerging sectors such as 5G, AI, automotive electronics, and power devices.
